{{Quote|That's the monster we saw in the sunberry grove.''"<br />"''It is the mantigrue, daughter.|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka and Chirpa|<ref name="Haunted Village">{{Ewoks|The Haunted Village}}</ref>}}
'''Condor dragons''', also known as '''mantigrues''', were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of flying, predatory [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] native to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. They were distinguished by their [[Bone/Legends|bony]] dorsal ridges, large [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]], [[Claw/Legends|clawed]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]], and [[Color/Legends|red]], leathery wings. Their yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] had sharp vision, and they inhabited cliffsides that ran through the [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. One condor dragon was the slave of [[Morag]], the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|The mantigrue's skin is too thick to hurt.|Logray|<ref name="Haunted Village" />}}
[[File:Mantigrue_in_flight.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A condor dragon in flight]]
Condor dragons,<ref name="DB" /> also referred to as mantigrues, were a hideous<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] [[Species/Legends|creature]] native to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]],<ref name="DB" /> a world located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Out Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> They had [[Bone/Legends|bony]] ridges that ran along their [[Skeleton/Legends|spines]], two [[Claw/Legends|clawed]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]], and [[Color/Legends|red]], leathery wings with an average span of three [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The dragons were also distinguished by their large [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]], piercing yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with sharp vision,<ref name="DB" /> and long, pointed beaks.<ref name="Guide" /> Condor dragons had green skin,<ref name="DB" /> and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] claimed that their skin was too thick to hurt.<ref name="Haunted Village" />

==Behavior==
[[File:Condordragons-woswfg.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A nest of condor dragons preys upon a rearing spider.]]
Condor dragons were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] predators. When hunting, condor dragons launched from high buttresses and flew in spiral swoops. They often screeched while attacking. Large condor dragons were reputed to snatch Ewoks from the backs of their [[Horse/Legends|pony]] steeds. Although condor dragons preyed upon many species, such as the [[rearing spider]]s, they found Ewok ponies to be unpalatable. Some condor dragons were also scavengers.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

The dragons usually captured prey alive and brought them to their eyries.<ref name="DB" /> Their nests could be found in [[Cave/Legends|caves]], canyons, and on crags. Condor dragons were both nocturnal and diurnal.<ref name="Wildlife" /> Some condor dragons could be trained, such as the one owned by the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]], [[Morag]].<ref name="CSWE-Mantigrue">{{CSWECite|II|287|mantigrue}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The sunberry trees have ripened at last. Tomorrow, you will return to the Ewok's forest and destroy every berry tree.|Morag, to her condor dragon|<ref name="Haunted Village" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the collector [[Jener Mich]] tasked a group of spacers to hunt and kill an unreasonable number of mantigrues.<ref name="SWG:MM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Mantigrue Marauder}}</ref>

Morag, the Tulgah witch, enslaved a condor dragon and used the beast to devour [[Sunberry tree/Legends|sunberry trees]], which were used by the Ewoks of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. Without the [[Sunberry/Legends|sunberries]], many Ewoks became sick. Long after,<ref name="Haunted Village" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="3 ABY note">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series, which include the appearance of a condor dragon in "[[The Haunted Village]]" and "[[Sunstar vs. Shadowstone]]," to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Morag's condor dragon [[Thief/Legends|stole]] two sunberry trees from a grove near Bright Tree Village, frightening the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]]. The dragon brought the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] to Morag, who then ordered the beast to destroy every [[Berry/Legends|berry]] tree in the grove. Aware of Morag's plot, the Ewok shaman Logray created a special [[Shadowroot soap|soap]] that was used to coat the trees and render them invisible. When the condor dragon returned to the grove, it was unable to see the sunberry trees and left.<ref name="Haunted Village" />

{{Unlicensedstart}}
On another occasion, Morag created a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] potion and commanded [[Gender/Legends|her]] condor dragon to disperse it across the Ewoks' berry [[Forest/Legends|forest]]. In response, Logray made an [[Logray's antidote|antidote]] that negated the poison's effects.<ref name="Perfect Antidote">{{StoryCite|story=Perfect Antidote|book=MyComyc|bformatted=''MyComyc'' 2}}</ref>
{{Unlicensedend}}

[[File:Condor_Dragon.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A condor dragon attacks Wicket Wystri Warrick.]]
In 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="3 ABY note" /> [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] of Bright Tree Village used [[Magic/Legends|magic]] to illustrate a tale in which Morag rode on the back of a condor dragon to steal the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar/Shadowstone]]. He also recounted how Logray, in his youth, had courageously lassoed the dragon's tail and flown to [[Mount Thunderstone]].<ref name="Sunstar vs. Shadowstone">{{Ewoks|Sunstar vs. Shadowstone}}</ref> Sometime later, Warrick engaged with [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]]&mdash;the Ewoks' warring cousins&mdash;and a condor dragon was set on him, grabbing him by the leg and taking flight. Warrick's friend [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] leapt onto the beast from a [[Hang-glider/Legends|hang glider]] and [[Death/Legends|slayed]] it with an [[Axe/Legends|axe]], rescuing Warrick.<ref name="Shadows of Endor">''[[Star Wars: Ewoks—Shadows of Endor]]''</ref>

After [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] [[Raid on Bright Tree Village|raided]] Bright Tree Village<ref name="Battle for Endor">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> in 3.5 ABY,<ref name="Behind the Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> the Ewok Warrick and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] girl [[Cindel Towani]] fled into a cave along a sheer cliff and encountered a hungry condor dragon.<ref name="Guide" /> Warrick accidentally awoke the beast and defended himself with a [[Spear/Legends|spear]], but Towani was grabbed by the dragon as it flew from the aerie. Warrick pursued the dragon on a hang glider and rescued Towani from its claws.<ref name="Battle for Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Condor_dragon.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
The condor dragon first appeared in the [[1984]] storybook ''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]'', by [[Joe Johnston]], and are identified as "mantigrues."<ref name="Adventures of Teebo">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref> The species later appeared in the [[1985]] film ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]'', on which Johnston also collaborated.<ref name="Battle for Endor" /> For the film, the dragon was realized by [[Industrial Light & Magic]] through stop-motion animation.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> According to ''Ewoks: The Battle for Endor'' co-director [[Ken Wheat]], the film's condor dragon was constructed from pieces of the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] puppet used in [[1983]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/rouser/encounters/ewoks_kenwheat.asp|text=Meeting Ken Wheat 'Battle for Endor' Co-Writer & Director at an Ewoks DVD Line Up|author=Alyse|date=2004-11-22|work=[https://www.theforce.net TheForce.net]|archivedate=20190730044647}}</ref>

The species was first identified as "condor dragon" in the [[1995]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'', which recounts events from the ''Ewoks'' film.<ref name="Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> In ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ([[2008]]), the terms "condor dragon" and "mantigrue" have two separate entries.<ref name="CSWE-CondorDragon">{{CSWECite|I|137|condor dragon}}</ref><ref name="CSWE-Mantigrue" /> The subtitles of ''Ewoks: The Battle for Endor'' misspell the species as "mantrigue."<ref name="Battle for Endor" />
